title: The homeomorphism group of the airplane as a kaleidoscopic topological group
difficulty_reason: H2 after old2380 and named mature tools are given: the author must still reconstruct the airplane-specific circular quotient and its exact wing/fiber geometry from four continuum axioms, including arc/no-remeeting control, saturated neighborhoods, infinite branch orders and exclusion of other branch points, then carry this geometry through continuity at circle fibers. These coupled global continuum-to-dendrite steps are nonroutine and exceed a standard doctoral qualifying exercise. The final Aut(S) action, dense-fiber completion, Polish open mapping and three-branch stabilizer argument are not credited again.
